function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 抱歉，我無法直接為你朋友提供 MBTI 類型，除非有足夠的資訊來進行評估。若你能提供一些關於他/她在不同情境下的行為或偏好（例如：外向/內向、感知/直覺、思考/情感、判斷/知覺等方面的百分比），我可以幫你使用評估工具來計算並解釋結果。或者，你也可以建議他/她自行完成一份 MBTI 測試，然後把測試結果告訴我，我再協助你分析。
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI." They want the friend's MBTI? Actually they wrote "MTBI" but likely means "MBTI". They want the MBTI type of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot guess or provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI type without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or suggest an assessment. So we should respond asking for details or suggest using the function to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. We could also use the function if they provide trait percentages. But they didn't provide any. So we should ask them to provide trait percentages or ask for more info. Also we can mention that we can't give MBTI without assessment. So we should politely ask for more info.
